title: Does any one else have an actual job in the Mall World?
content: Some background, in the 70's, 80's, and 90's my father owned several shoe stores that were in prominent locations and malls in my state. A few were freestanding and in commuter hubs. And a few others were in various malls. Like most people in family businesses as soon as I was old enough I began working in the business on weekends, and continued to do so though college. By the time I was college age there was one particular store of his I worked in most of the time. This store was in a mall. I've been a frequent lucid dreamer my whole life. And I've also dreamt of the Mall world for a very long time. Often I dream of this particular store, and of working there, but it's not in the mall it was located irl. It's in a much more vast structure, i.e. Mall World. Though I didn't know others had dreams of vast Mall Worlds until very recently. Anyway, often when I have these dreams I go into a lucid state as I realize this store has been gone for near 25 years. So I'll leave the store, walk around, and marvel at the realism. Sometimes I have a hard time remaining asleep once I go lucid, and wake up. Other times I'll remain asleep long enough to "test" the environment. Meaning "feel" the solidity of objects, walls, etc. I've also felt and noted that I could feel surface temperatures on things. Other times I'm being chased. Or having more mundane interactions and conversations with people. Sometimes I just explore because I can. The uncanny thing is how many of the locations I encounter in this place will be there from dream to dream. Almost as if this is a place, not just a figment of my imagination. As I mentioned earlier it wasn't until very recently that I heard of this sub and found out that other people also dream of the Mall world. So I figured I'd ask if any one besides me is gainfully employed at the Mall World. And if so, what's your job? Me, I work at the shoe store. Come in an say hi some time.
